name: ft-authz-negative-admin-mod-split
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 2 / section 5): the SPLIT re-run for ft-authz-negative-admin-mod. Run 1 (batch1b) passed 18/26 but 8 steps were 429-blocked by the shared 10/h ip:unknown api-post bucket (doors 5, 6, 9-14 - the KNOWN QUIRK class, a restart trigger not a door failure). This split runs ONLY the 8 blocked doors against a fresh dev restart (fresh in-memory buckets): Sam Rivera (u_mod, site_mod, the real scrypt door) signs in and probes the 8 POST admin doors with a minted CSRF token so the ROLE gate answers. Every door must refuse with 403 (a moderator is NOT an admin). The passed doors (1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 15 + the sign-in legs) are NOT re-run - their receipts live in the batch1b devlog + the main scenario receipt.

steps.name: admin-door-5-group-permissions-403-with-csrf
steps.expr: (() => { const c = new XMLHttpRequest(); c.open('GET', '/api/auth/csrf', false); c.send(); const t = (JSON.parse(c.responseText) || {}).csrfToken || ''; const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/admin/group-permissions', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.setRequestHeader('X-CSRF-Token', t); x.send(JSON.stringify({ groupId: 'g_austin', permission: 'can_post_listings', value: true })); return 'csrf=' + (t ? 'ok' : 'none') + ' status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()
